summary: RETEST of Bug 1 (UPI visibility in Razorpay checkout on /employer web preview). Verified CHECKOUT_DISPLAY_CONFIG is correctly imported/applied in both payments.tsx::openWebCheckout (line 84) AND RazorpayModal.tsx WebView HTML (line 61). Ran full flow: seeded session token → /employer → unlock-cta-btn → pay-confirm-btn → Razorpay iframe opened → mobile 9000000042 filled → Continue. RESULT: 'Pay via UPI' block STILL ABSENT. Only 'Cards, Netbanking & Wallets' block renders (Cards / Netbanking / Wallet options). No GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, UPI ID collect, or QR shown anywhere. ROOT CAUSE: NOT a code bug. Razorpay's own preferences API confirms merchant entitlement: `GET https://api.razorpay.com/v1/preferences?key_id=rzp_test_TAqEg3Dat2LQ2C` returns methods.upi=false and upi_type={collect:0, intent:0}. The test merchant account has UPI DISABLED in Razorpay Dashboard, so Razorpay strips the UPI block server-side regardless of the client's config.display.blocks.upi. This is a Razorpay Dashboard/account entitlement issue, NOT a WorkHop code issue. Card/Netbanking/Wallet render correctly — no regression from the config change.

integration_issues.issue: UPI block does not render in Razorpay checkout despite correct client-side CHECKOUT_DISPLAY_CONFIG. Razorpay preferences API confirms merchant key_id rzp_test_TAqEg3Dat2LQ2C has methods.upi=false and upi_type={collect:0, intent:0}. Client config cannot enable a method that is disabled at the merchant account level — Razorpay filters out any display block whose method is not entitled. Cards/Netbanking/Wallets render fine (no regression).

action_items: This is NOT a code fix. Enable UPI on the Razorpay test merchant account (rzp_test_TAqEg3Dat2LQ2C) at Razorpay Dashboard → Settings → Payment Methods → toggle UPI ON. Verify with: curl -s 'https://api.razorpay.com/v1/preferences?key_id=rzp_test_TAqEg3Dat2LQ2C' — methods.upi must be true and upi_type.collect and/or upi_type.intent must be 1.

If the test key is a shared/demo key that cannot be modified, provision a different Razorpay TEST key_id where UPI is enabled and update RAZORPAY_KEY_ID + RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET in /app/backend/.env, then restart backend.
The CHECKOUT_DISPLAY_CONFIG in RazorpayModal.tsx and payments.tsx is CORRECT and can be kept as-is — it will surface the UPI block properly the moment UPI is enabled on the merchant account.

Communicate this finding to the end user: 'GPay/PhonePe/UPI are missing because the Razorpay test merchant currently has UPI disabled on its dashboard, not because of a code bug. Enable UPI in the Razorpay Dashboard → Settings → Payment Methods.'
critical_code_review_comments: CHECKOUT_DISPLAY_CONFIG is well-structured: UPI block first with flows=[intent,collect,qr] + apps=[google_pay,phonepe,paytm], sequence=['block.upi','block.other'], show_default_blocks:false. Correctly exported from RazorpayModal.tsx and imported/applied in payments.tsx line 84 (web) — no code changes needed.

Note on `apps: ['google_pay','phonepe','paytm']` — these are intent-flow apps only launchable on Android devices. On desktop web without these apps, Razorpay would normally fall back to the `collect` and `qr` flows (which are also declared). Both would render if UPI were enabled on the merchant.

rca_of_issue: REPRODUCTION: (1) Set localStorage workhop_session_token=test_token_workhop_e2e (2) GET /employer (3) Tap unlock-cta-btn → tap pay-confirm-btn (4) Razorpay iframe loads (URL: https://api.razorpay.com/v1/checkout/public?...) (5) Fill mobile 9000000042 → Continue → observe Payment Options screen. EXPECTED: 'Pay via UPI' block at top with GPay/PhonePe/Paytm or UPI ID collect + QR. ACTUAL: Only 'Cards, Netbanking & Wallets' block visible. Content search: idx_of('pay via upi')=-1 in iframe HTML. RCA: Called Razorpay's public preferences API — GET https://api.razorpay.com/v1/preferences?key_id=rzp_test_TAqEg3Dat2LQ2C. Response: methods.upi=false, methods.upi_type={collect:0,intent:0}, methods.card=true, methods.netbanking=true, methods.wallet=true. Razorpay Checkout renders only methods where the merchant preferences.methods.<method>=true; the client's display.blocks config cannot override merchant-account entitlement. MITIGATION: Enable UPI in Razorpay Dashboard for the test account (Settings → Payment Methods → UPI toggle), OR swap RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET to a test merchant with UPI enabled. No code change needed — the frontend CHECKOUT_DISPLAY_CONFIG is correct.
